AVIATION — MOCK EXAM #1
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: AVIATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Speaker
   B. CPU
   C. Keyboard
   D. Monitor

2. When learning Aircraft Systems, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Systems.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Systems.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Systems.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Systems.

3. When learning Aircraft Related Drawing: Surface Development, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

7. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Remove all guards
   B. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Run with the tool

8. When learning Aircraft Stability, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Stability.

12. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Input Cable Tester
   B. Internal Cooking Timer
   C. Information and Communication Technology
   D. International Cricket Team

13. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Overload every socket
   B. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   C. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   D. Ignore burnt cables

14. When learning Flight Safety, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Flight Safety.

----
